intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, but they are very different institutions. This page compares recorded fees, the placement years we hold, and admission routes, using official sites opened in {{year}}.
Amity University Patna vs IIT Patna is a private university against a public Indian Institute of Technology. That difference in character matters more than a raw year-fee gap.

sections.heading: Amity University Patna vs IIT Patna for Ph.D: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIT Patna if you want a public IIT doctorate in engineering, sciences or humanities, with recorded year totals of ₹27,150 and ₹16,500, which may reflect different student categories.
Choose Amity University Patna if you want a private-university Ph.D in information technology, with recorded year totals of ₹70,000 and ₹50,000, and a GATE route listed on our records.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For IIT Patna we hold Total Fees year figures of ₹27,150 and ₹16,500 on several doctoral rows, including electrical engineering, mathematics and humanities. These look like category-wise year amounts, not a single invented programme total.

For Amity University Patna we hold Total Fees year figures of ₹70,000 and ₹50,000 for the Doctor of Philosophy in Information Technology, including a part-time option. Confirm which amount applies on the official notice.
IIT fees can also depend on institute assistantships and hostel. Recheck the current Ph.D fee circular on iitp.ac.in and amity.edu/bihar before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Amity University Patna has a 2023 Ph.D Information Technology row of ₹7 lakh average and ₹27 lakh highest. Treat that as a historical record for that year, and ask how many doctoral students it covers.
IIT Patna's only doctoral placement row here is from 2016, with an ₹11 lakh average and no highest figure recorded. That year is too old to use as a current comparison.
A Ph.D decision should also weigh stipends, supervisor fit and research labs, not only a package cell.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Amity University Patna is listed with GATE. IIT Patna has no exam mapped on this page, but IIT doctoral admissions typically use a test and interview; follow the official notification.
IIT Patna lists doctorates across several engineering and science departments. Amity's listed rows here are in information technology, including part-time. Match the department first.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Patna, Bihar, so the city is the same. The campuses themselves, and the research facilities, are not interchangeable.
IIT Patna is a public technical institute. Amity University Patna is a private university campus. Visit the department and lab you would join, not only the main gate.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick IIT Patna if an IIT doctorate, public-institute setting and supervisor fit are the priority, and you have confirmed the official category-wise fee and stipend.
Pick Amity University Patna if the listed IT doctorate, including the part-time option, matches your plan and the recorded year fees are acceptable.
Do not use the 2016 IIT row as a current package. If placements matter, ask for a recent doctoral outcomes note from both sides.

faqs.question: What Ph.D fees are on record for IIT Patna and Amity University Patna?
faqs.answer: IIT Patna has year totals of ₹27,150 and ₹16,500 on several doctoral rows, which may be category-wise. Amity University Patna has year totals of ₹70,000 and ₹50,000 for the IT doctorate. Confirm the official circulars.

faqs.question: Which side has the more recent Ph.D placement record?
faqs.answer: Amity University Patna has a 2023 IT doctorate row of ₹7 lakh average and ₹27 lakh highest. IIT Patna's only row here is from 2016 and is too old to treat as current.

faqs.question: Is IIT Patna a government institute?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our records list IIT Patna as a public institute and Amity University Patna as a private university, both in Patna.

faqs.question: Do these Ph.D programmes accept GATE?
faqs.answer: Amity University Patna is listed with GATE. IIT Patna has no exam mapped on this page, so follow its official doctoral notification for tests and interviews.

faqs.question: Are the research areas the same?
faqs.answer: Not on this page. IIT Patna lists doctorates across several engineering and science departments. Amity's listed rows here are in information technology, including a part-time option.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Patna?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Patna, Bihar, though the campuses and research facilities differ.
